candidates.title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
candidates.reason: Block-GTQ directly targets long-context KV-cache memory and bandwidth with RoPE-aware mixed-bit allocation, includes a packed serving path, reports 3.24x cache compression, 1.34x speedup at 128K, and enables contexts where fp16 OOMs.

candidates.title: High-accuracy Low-Bit KV-Cache Quantization via Local Distribution Restoration
candidates.reason: DGAP addresses 1-bit KV-cache quality collapse with selective local-distribution restoration while keeping the low-bit cache footprint, directly matching KV-memory and long-context inference lineages.

candidates.title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
candidates.reason: TraceLab provides a real coding-agent serving trace with roughly 4,300 sessions and identifies concrete serving opportunities around prefill, prefix caching, tool latency, and KV-cache management.

candidates.title: QueueBreak: A Trace-to-Diagnosis Pipeline for Tail Latency in Agentic LLM Services
candidates.reason: QueueBreak decomposes agentic LLM service tail latency into pre-execution and execution components and validates admission-control/capacity interventions, fitting serving observability and scheduling lineages.

candidates.title: Towards Efficient and Reliable On-Device Multi-Agent Systems: Challenges, Technologies and Explorations
candidates.reason: The paper includes a cross-layer on-device framework combining MoE-based parameter offloading with real-time validation and reports lower memory usage, connecting offload, MoE, and edge inference.
